body: GET /api/tickets/:id/relations returns incoming and outgoing edges with counterpart ticket (404 for unknown ticket). Detail shows 'Relationships (n)' grouped from the open ticket's perspective with directional labels (Blocks/Blocked by, Implements/Implemented by, Validates/Validated by, Supersedes/Superseded by, Duplicates/Duplicated by, Related to), counterpart status and stable ticket links; parent path stays separate in the breadcrumbs. Display/navigation only.
author: claude
